static_traits.name: Chen Ming
static_traits.family_status: Mother is a cancer survivor; has a few friends to confide in, but finds it hard to share incompetence and Self-doubt
static_traits.social_status: Interactions with friends affected by an incident of being mocked for 'burnt pizza'; Self-doubt extending to interpersonal connection ability
static_traits.medical_history: No significant physical illness history; has not received prior psychotherapy
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly cooperative; tone neutral, slightly nervous; able to describe subjective experiences with a tendency toward self-criticism

basic_info.main_problem: I want to discuss my incompetence and Self-doubt, which were triggered when friends criticized my cooking, and gradually spread to other areas of life.
basic_info.core_demands: This friends' comment made me realize Self-doubt and incompetence are affecting my self-esteem and overall well-being, so I hope to address and change them through counseling.
growth_experiences: Mother once had cancer and recovered successfully; this major family event forms the client's background information.

special_situations.event: Friends comment that the pizza I made is burnt and laugh at me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If criticized or erring once, it means I am not good at this, I am incapable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubling cooking practice, strictly following recipes and using timers; seeking others' approval to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never learn to make pizza well

special_situations.event: When facing challenges or receiving any form of criticism from others
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot get it right the first time or errors are pointed out, it means my overall ability is insufficient, I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Sharing fewer true feelings with friends; easing unease by seeking external approval
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good at anything

special_situations.event: After interacting with friends, begins to doubt her interpersonal skills and ability to connect with people
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others mock me for my mistakes, it means I am interpersonally incapable too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding expressing incompetence and Self-doubt, staying emotionally restrained to avoid being judged again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good at connecting with people

special_situations.event: Making a small mistake while practicing cooking
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Any small mistake proves I cannot do well, overall incapable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Constantly practicing more, strictly following steps, trying to undo unease with perfect performance
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This small mistake shows I am incapable

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as capable, hopes one's performance is seen positively
core_conflict.fear: Fearing criticism and mockery, worrying about being totally negated and humiliated
defense_goal: Avoiding being negated again by internalizing others' evaluations and raising standards; staying restrained and self-monitoring to maintain self-esteem security

object_relations.self_representation: A not-good-enough failure prone to blame

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When others point out mistakes, mention 'cooking failure', or offer criticism
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Understanding others' single comment as total negation of one's overall worth and ability (transference: treating external evaluation as decisive truth)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Gentle yet steady tone, first empathizing with their shame and unease, then inviting distinguishing 'specific behavioral feedback' from 'overall self-worth', using specific questioning to help them see the boundaries of situations and evidence.

manifestations: Self-doubt from being mocked for burnt pizza, beginning to question one's interpersonal connection ability
Difficulty sharing incompetence and Self-doubt with friends
outcomes: Increased Anxiety and Self-denial when facing challenges

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Frequent Self-denial ('I am not good at anything')
Worried that failure will lead to worse feelings; stays cautious about action
Excessively focusing on one's insufficiency after others' criticism

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Internalizes a friend's single mockery into a comprehensive judgment of one's own ability
Takes external criticism as a hard standard for measuring personal worth

positive_force: Willing to try different methods and stay open-minded (willing to do behavioral experiments)
Has some reflection ability, able to observe and describe one's automatic thoughts
Has a few contactable friends as potential support resources
negative_force: Tendency to seek external validation to confirm self-worth
Personalizes criticism; easily extends a single event to overall ability
Difficulty sharing vulnerable feelings with others, so support cannot fully enter

target_behavior.behavior: Strong Self-denial and withdrawal when facing challenges or receiving criticism (cognitive and emotional reactions together)
antecedent: Trying new tasks or skills (e.g., cooking)
When others point out mistakes or give negative feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalizing others' criticism as judgment of overall ability, forming the core belief 'I am incapable'; with overgeneralization and black-and-white cognition.
target_behavior.function: Escaping failure and shame, temporarily easing unease through caution and seeking external approval
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, timid actions, declining daily confidence; doubting interpersonal connection, blocked learning and skill growth
